title: Agent Skills Marketplace
description: Schema for an agent skill marketplace catalog

version.description: Semantic version of the marketplace catalog

skills.description: List of skills available in this marketplace

description.description: Short description of what the skill does and when to invoke it

path.description: Path to the skill directory. In marketplace.json use a repository-root-relative path (e.g. "build-check"). In an individual skill.json use "." since the file is already inside the skill directory.

skillFile.description: Path to the packaged .skill archive. In marketplace.json use a repository-root-relative path. In an individual skill.json use a path relative to the skill directory.

readme.description: Path to the skill's SKILL.md. In marketplace.json use a repository-root-relative path. In an individual skill.json use a path relative to the skill directory.

allowedTools.description: List of tools the skill is allowed to use
